Call 438-885-6780 About Lefebvre Park Explore the area Lefebvre Park is a very good neighbourhood to buy a home in for those who prefer a relaxed environment. This part of the city features not that much greenery; to be more specific, residents will find that a large number of streets have sub-par tree coverage. However, reaching green spaces from numerous locations in the neighbourhood, such as Parc Lefebvre, is very easy since there are a few of them close by for residents to explore. Most areas in this neighbourhood are very quiet, as the streets are usually very peaceful. This information is provided by a third party data source.
